mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, attempt, status, mode, queued_at, started_at, finished_at, created_by FROM runs WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.project_id, COALESCE(MAX(r.attempt), 0)::integer AS last_attempt FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.organization_id = t.organization_id AND r.task_id = t.id WHERE t.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND t.id = #{taskId} GROUP BY t.id FOR UPDATE OF t

SELECT mp.id, mp.provider, mp.model, mp.credential_handle_id FROM model_profiles mp JOIN credential_handles ch ON ch.organization_id = mp.organization_id AND ch.id = mp.credential_handle_id WHERE mp.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND mp.status = 'active' AND ch.status = 'active' AND ch.secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND (#{modelProfileId}::text IS NULL OR mp.id = #{modelProfileId}) ORDER BY mp.created_at ASC, mp.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runs (id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, attempt, status, mode, execution_profile, model_snapshot, permission_policy, resource_limits, selected_source_ids, usage, queued_at, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{attempt}, 'queued', #{mode}, 'work', #{modelSnapshot, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{permissionPolicy, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{resourceLimits, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{selectedSourceIds, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{usage, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, now(), #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO run_leases (run_id, organization_id, status, available_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{organizationId}, 'available', now())
mapper.update: UPDATE runs SET status = 'provisioning', worker_generation = #{generation}, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'queued'

WITH cancelled AS ( UPDATE runs SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'cancelling' RETURNING id, organization_id ) UPDATE run_leases l SET status = 'completed', available_at = now(), updated_at = now() FROM cancelled c WHERE l.organization_id = c.organization_id AND l.run_id = c.id AND l.status IN ('available','released')
mapper.select: SELECT l.generation FROM runs r JOIN run_leases l ON l.organization_id = r.organization_id AND l.run_id = r.id WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND r.status = 'cancelling' AND l.status = 'leased'

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT run_id, organization_id FROM run_leases WHERE status IN ('available','released') AND available_at <= now() ORDER BY available_at, run_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE run_leases l SET status = 'leased', lease_id = gen_random_uuid()::text, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = now() + (#{durationMs} * interval '1 millisecond'), generation = generation + 1, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now() FROM candidate c WHERE l.organization_id = c.organization_id AND l.run_id = c.run_id RETURNING l.lease_id, l.organization_id, l.run_id, l.lease_owner AS owner, l.generation, l.lease_expires_at AS expires_at

UPDATE run_leases SET lease_expires_at = now() + (#{durationMs} * interval '1 millisecond'), updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND lease_id = #{leaseId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND generation = #{generation} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_expires_at > now() RETURNING lease_id, organization_id, run_id, lease_owner AS owner, generation, lease_expires_at AS expires_at
mapper.update: UPDATE run_leases SET status = 'released', available_at = now() + (#{delayMs} * interval '1 millisecond'), lease_id = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND lease_id = #{leaseId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND generation = #{generation} AND status = 'leased'

UPDATE run_leases l SET status = CASE WHEN r.status IN ('completed','failed','cancelled') THEN 'completed' ELSE 'released' END, available_at = now(), lease_id = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() FROM runs r WHERE l.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND l.run_id = #{runId} AND l.lease_id = #{leaseId} AND l.generation = #{generation} AND l.lease_owner = #{owner} AND l.status = 'leased' AND r.organization_id = l.organization_id AND r.id = l.run_id
mapper.select: SELECT resource_limits, permission_policy FROM runs WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'queued'

SELECT t.token_hash, t.organization_id, t.run_id, t.generation, t.lease_id, l.lease_owner, t.expires_at, t.worker_session_id, t.worker_id FROM worker_run_tokens t JOIN run_leases l ON l.organization_id = t.organization_id AND l.run_id = t.run_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND t.revoked_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at > now() AND l.generation = t.generation AND l.lease_id = t.lease_id AND l.status = 'leased' AND l.lease_expires_at > now()
mapper.update: UPDATE worker_run_tokens SET worker_session_id = #{sessionId}, worker_id = #{workerId}, registered_at = COALESCE(registered_at, now()) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (worker_session_id IS NULL OR worker_session_id = #{sessionId}) AND (worker_id IS NULL OR worker_id = #{workerId})
UPDATE worker_run_tokens SET revoked_at = now() WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE worker_run_tokens SET expires_at = LEAST(#{expiresAt}, now() + (#{durationMs} * interval '1 millisecond')) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.project_id, r.task_id, t.type AS task_type, t.title AS task_title, t.objective AS task_objective, t.constraints AS task_constraints, t.acceptance_criteria AS task_acceptance_criteria, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', m.id, 'role', m.role, 'content', m.content, 'created_at', m.created_at) ORDER BY m.created_at, m.id) FROM task_messages m WHERE m.organization_id = r.organization_id AND m.task_id = r.task_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS messages, p.repository_binding, r.permission_policy, r.model_snapshot, r.resource_limits, r.selected_source_ids, r.mode, r.execution_profile, r.checkpoint_key, l.lease_expires_at FROM runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.organization_id = r.organization_id AND t.id = r.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.organization_id = r.organization_id AND p.id = r.project_id JOIN run_leases l ON l.organization_id = r.organization_id AND l.run_id = r.id WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND l.generation = #{generation} AND l.lease_id = #{leaseId} AND l.status = 'leased' AND l.lease_expires_at > now()
SELECT id, kind, display_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, blob_key FROM sources WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id IN #{id} AND status = 'ready'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_events (public_event_id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, run_id, generation, seq, type, occurred_at, payload) SELECT #{publicEventId}, r.organization_id, r.project_id, r.task_id, r.id, #{generation}, #{seq}, #{type}, #{occurredAt}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler} FROM runs r JOIN run_leases l ON l.organization_id = r.organization_id AND l.run_id = r.id WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND l.generation = #{generation} AND l.lease_id = #{leaseId} AND l.status = 'leased' AND l.lease_expires_at > now() ON CONFLICT (run_id, generation, seq) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0)::bigint FROM run_events WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND generation = #{generation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approvals (id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, run_id, kind, scope, status, risk_level, action_preview, target, request_hash, requested_at, expires_at) SELECT #{id}, r.organization_id, r.project_id, r.task_id, r.id, #{kind}, #{scope}, 'pending', #{riskLevel}, #{actionPreview}, #{target, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{requestHash}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt} FROM runs r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.id = #{runId} ON CONFLICT (organization_id, id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE runs SET status = CASE WHEN #{type} = 'run.started' AND status = 'provisioning' THEN 'running' WHEN #{type} = 'run.approval_requested' THEN 'waiting_for_approval' WHEN #{type} = 'run.terminal' THEN #{terminalStatus} ELSE status END, started_at = CASE WHEN #{type} = 'run.started' THEN COALESCE(started_at, #{occurredAt}) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{type} = 'run.terminal' THEN #{occurredAt} ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT public_event_id AS event_id, organization_id, project_id, task_id, run_id, generation, seq, type, occurred_at AS timestamp, payload FROM run_events WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND event_id > COALESCE((SELECT event_id FROM run_events WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND public_event_id = #{cursor}), 0) AND (#{projectId}::text IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId}) AND (#{taskId}::text IS NULL OR task_id = #{taskId}) AND (#{runId}::text IS NULL OR run_id = #{runId}) ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT response_body FROM idempotency_keys WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND scope = #{scope} AND idempotency_key = #{key} AND expires_at > now()
SELECT request_hash FROM idempotency_keys WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND scope = #{scope} AND idempotency_key = #{key} AND expires_at > now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (organization_id, scope, idempotency_key, request_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{scope}, #{key}, #{hash}, now() + interval '24 hours') ON CONFLICT (organization_id, scope, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT checkpoint_key FROM runs WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{runId} AND checkpoint_key = #{checkpointKey}

SELECT r.model_snapshot, ch.secret_ciphertext, ch.status AS credential_status FROM runs r JOIN credential_handles ch ON ch.organization_id = r.organization_id AND ch.id = r.model_snapshot->>'credentialHandle' WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.id = #{runId} AND r.status IN ('queued','provisioning','running','waiting_for_approval','cancelling')
SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'pending' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) ORDER BY requested_at ASC

SELECT a.id, a.organization_id, a.project_id, a.task_id, a.run_id, a.kind, a.scope, a.status, a.risk_level, a.action_preview, a.target, a.request_hash, a.requested_at, a.expires_at, a.decided_by, a.decision_reason, a.decided_at, a.decision_idempotency_key, r.permission_policy, r.status AS run_status FROM approvals a JOIN runs r ON r.organization_id = a.organization_id AND r.id = a.run_id WHERE a.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND a.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE approvals SET status = 'expired' WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE runs SET status = 'queued', updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'waiting_for_approval'

UPDATE run_leases SET status = 'available', available_at = now(), lease_id = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('released','available')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_events (organization_id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, r.permission_policy, r.status AS run_status FROM approvals a JOIN runs r ON r.organization_id = a.organization_id AND r.id = a.run_id WHERE a.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND a.run_id = #{runId} AND a.status IN ('approved','rejected') AND (a.decision_delivered_generation IS NULL OR a.decision_delivered_generation = #{generation}) ORDER BY a.decided_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF a
mapper.update: UPDATE approvals SET decision_delivered_at = COALESCE(decision_delivered_at, now()), decision_delivered_generation = COALESCE(decision_delivered_generation, #{generation}), consumed_at = CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN COALESCE(consumed_at, now()) ELSE consumed_at END, consumption_idempotency_key = CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN COALESCE(consumption_idempotency_key, #{consumptionKey}) ELSE consumption_idempotency_key END WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND (decision_delivered_generation IS NULL OR decision_delivered_generation = #{generation})
